item.title: Six in 10 Leaders Bet Big on Robots. Only Four in 10 Are Ready.
item.summary: NEWS HIGHLIGHTS Six in 10 senior business and IT leaders, robotics specialists, government and healthcare officials expect their organizations to operate robot fleets within five years. Leaders predict full-scale robotics deployment could double operational output. 67% believe they will be ready to manage a mixed human-robot workforce by 2030. 74% believe workforce planning and robotics … The post Six in 10 Leaders Bet Big on Robots. Only Four in 10 Are Ready. appeared first on Newsroom .
